title: update_delivery_state allows state regressions (delivered→pending)
description: message.rs::update_delivery_state updates delivery_state unconditionally with no WHERE clause constraining prior state. A caller bug or retry race could flip a 'delivered' message back to 'pending'. Fix: add WHERE delivery_state NOT IN ('delivered','received','failed') or a typed state machine guard at the call site. Phase 1: outbox retry loop is the only caller and it is single-threaded, so this is latent not active.
